newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE COLLECTED ABOUT 942BLN DRACHS FROM T-BILLS - SOURCE.
newsitem.headline: GREECE COLLECTED ABOUT 942BLN DRACHS FROM T-BILLS - SOURCE.

text.p: Greek state coffers were filled with about 942 billion drachmas from the private placement of T-bills and open sale of T-bills on Monday, a monetary source told Reuters.
Three,-six- and 12-month T-bills were on sale Monday at unchanged rates of 11.90 percent, 12.10 percent and 12.70 percent respectively.
The state agreed to privately place 300 billion drachmas worth of T-bills with a large state bank last week, dealers said.
The treasury had raised about 60 billion drachmas worth of three and six-month T-bills issued in April and July.
The official T-bill figure will be available later, sources said.
